TermTranslation.definition: An operation to remove a tumor and some healthy tissue around it so that most of the breast remains.
A treatment that adds, blocks or removes hormones in the body to treat a disease.
An operation to remove a breast lump or tumour along with a very small amount of healthy tissue around it.
An operation to remove a breast.
An operation to a part of the body to help it work better, look better or to help heal a wound.
